verses.text: For the music director. To the tune "Do Not Destroy." A poem of David, written when he ran away from Saul into the cave. Be kind to me, God, be kind to me, because I come to you for safety. I will find safety in the shadow of your wings until the disaster has passed.
I cry out to God Most High, to God who does everything he planned for me.
He sends help from heaven and saves me. He scolds those who are chasing me. Selah. God sends his faithful love and his truth.
I am surrounded by lions. I lie among people who are on fire with hatred, people whose teeth are spears and arrows and whose tongues are sharp swords.
God, be honoured above the skies! Let your glory be over all the earth!
They set a net to catch my feet. I was bowed down in distress. They dug a pit in my path, but they fell into it themselves. Selah.
My heart is steady, God. My heart is steady. I will sing and make music.
Wake up, my soul! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.
Lord, I will thank you among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.
Your great and faithful love reaches to the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
God, be honoured above the skies. Let your glory be over all the earth.
